units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19a:14">Ab. Zar. 19ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 13:11">Prov. XIII, 11</cite>) <he>ואם קוֹבֵץ על יד ירבה</he> but if he collects learning little by little, he will increase it, v. <cite ref="H00068"><he>חֲבִילָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 54b">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> (corr. acc.).—Part. pass. <cite ref="S00039"><he>קָבוּץ</he></cite>; pl. <he>קְבוּצִים</he>, <he>קְבוּצִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:2:5">Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ</cite> top <he>נוטל את הק׳ עמו</he> (not <he>עמה</he>) he may take with him the collected rakings.
Gitt. 56ᵇ (ref. to Koh. VIII, 10) א״ת קבורים אלא קבוצים read not ḳ’burim (buried) but ḳ’butsim (the wicked taking up heaps of spoil).

senses.gloss: same, to collect. Ib. 7ᵃ quot. in Ar. (ref. to Josh. XV, 21 קבצאל ועדר ויגור) כל המְקַבֵּץ עדרים … יגור וכ׳ he who gathers flocks (students) to the study of the Law, shall dwell in the partition of the Lord.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 107:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CVII</cite> <he>אני אֲקַבֵּץ וכ׳</he> I (the Lord) will gather you in due time; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 112a:12">Snh. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>נִקְבָּצִין לתוכה</he> those things which can be brought together to the condemned city (with ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 13:17">Deut. XIII, 17</cite>).
<cite ref="Megillah 17b:16">Meg. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שנִתְקַבְּצוּ גליות וכ׳</he> when the diasporas are collected, judgment is executed on the wicked.
<cite ref="Zevachim 116a:23">Zeb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>נִתְקַבְּצוּ כולם אצל וכ׳</he> they all gathered themselves around Balaam; a. fr.
